purpose: Grounded robot sculpture revision; concept only

concepts.title: 01 · 站立款
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished game concept image of a PHYSICAL robot-dragon sculpture in an existing campus town game.
Reference image 1: mascot identity, branching blue antlers, white round head, blue scalloped cloud mane, pink inner ears, small tail ending in a flame. Reference image 2: exact environment and art-direction context.
The previous iteration was rejected for being too abstract, ornate and fantasy-like. Completely redesign it as a simple, grounded, instantly understandable, friendly knowledgeable ROBOT DRAGON. Think thoughtfully designed campus service robot made into a modest public sculpture, with believable fabricated parts, clear proportions, quiet personality. Keep original short rounded dragon identity and familiar blue-white colors, but no hoodie/backpack.
Large simple off-white enamel shell panels, matte cobalt forearms/feet and short antenna antlers, charcoal flexible joint rings, a few clean seams, soft blue electronic eyes, translucent amber flame tail-tip lamp. Buildable coherent construction, about eight major parts. Very limited surface details. Soft friendly face with expressive eyes, composed slight smile, closed mouth. No gold, jewels, halo, rings, orbital symbols, floating, globe, magic, shrine, armor, ornate pedestal, royal crown, engraved runes, abstract cosmic installation, extra props, fake diagrams or motion arrows. Feet or seat visibly supported; correct shadows.
Match the clean colorful illustrated 2.5D world in image 2. High-quality game prop concept painting with precise silhouette and soft shading, no photo realism or grungy textures. The robot sculpture stands about 1.7 times a normal resident height, grounded and approachable, its shape readable even small.
Landscape 3:2 concept board with just TWO compositions: left 52 percent is a large full-body three-quarter view on a plain light neutral background; right 48 percent is a contextual close view of the exact same design on the rear lakeside terrace of the town plaza, with existing stone steps and lake and some trees. A single small ordinary blue-white mascot resident (reference 1 with hoodie) stands nearby for scale. Natural daytime lighting. Correct perspective; enough negative space. One tiny restrained title in upper left only, as specified. No multiple tiny panels, no pixel thumbnails, no night views. The robot is the clear subject.
Text (verbatim): "01 · 站立款".
Design: standing upright on both flat feet, naturally relaxed short legs, one arm bent with open hand inviting a question, other hand resting by its side. Recognizable branching blue antlers with TWO rounded branches each, not huge. Blue scalloped mane is one manufactured ring behind the white head. A single inset deep navy eye display has two expressive blue LED eyes, with a small white dragon muzzle below it, pink inner ears at the sides. Upper body is simple white rounded shell with a modest small circular status light, compact blue elbows and toes, short curled tail. No round gems. A very thin oval stone footing at ground level, not elevated steps. The result must look like a practical intelligent little-dragon robot that belongs on campus.

Text (verbatim): "02 · 思考款".
Design: the robot-dragon is seated on one plain low pale-stone bench, feet planted on the ground, one elbow resting on knee with that hand gently touching its chin, head angled attentively toward a visitor. The other hand naturally rests on the bench, leaving one obvious empty seat alongside for a visitor. Recognizable blue branching antlers of compact length; white rounded face with BLUE optical lens eyes inset separately into the face, not a black helmet; sculpted blue scalloped mane, pink inner ears, compact white rounded torso, cobalt forearms and feet, charcoal pivot joints. Soft knowing closed-mouth smile and attentive gaze. Short tail curls near the bench foot with a small amber flame-shaped lamp. Simple solid sculptural presence, calm approachable teacher-like personality. No book or tablet, no extra signage, no extravagant pedestal.
